description: This source file defines the `AudioInputDeviceObserver` class, which manages monitoring of audio input devices on macOS. It provides methods to obtain default and active input device UIDs, start and stop listening for device changes, and handle related system events. The class uses CoreAudio APIs to interact with audio hardware and system properties.

classes.name: AudioInputDeviceObserver
classes.description: Manages monitoring of system audio input devices on macOS, providing methods to retrieve device info and listen for device changes.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceUID
methods.description: Returns the UID of the default audio input device, if available.

methods.name: aliveInputDeviceUIDs
methods.description: Retrieves a set of UIDs of currently connected and alive input audio devices.

methods.name: hasUsableDefaultInputDevice
methods.description: Checks whether the system has a default input device that is alive and usable.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary string of the default input device, including its name and UID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins listening for changes in audio input devices and the default input device. Accepts a callback invoked on device changes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for audio device change notifications.
